translation: Bitter in flavor, cold, non-toxic. It treats cold damage (傷寒), headache, chills and fever, miasma qi (瘴氣), malignant poison (惡毒), vexation and agitation (煩躁), fullness and stuffiness (滿悶), vacuity-labor (虛勞), wheezing and gasping (喘吸), and cold-pain of both feet (兩腳疼冷); also kills the various poisons of the fetus of the six domestic animals (六畜胎子諸毒).
